CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content present.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate set) and its origin/access status are both explicitly recorded for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change statement linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report names specific content items (color-tagged coordinate sets) with explicit attributes.

D.rationale: Content identity (coordinate set) is recorded separately from its origin/access status for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report explicitly records how content entries are presented/represented (origin kinds, inherited/current/candidate), indicating organization/access.
